listing.name: XCOM Player Flags
listing.summary: I noticed a Terra Invicta flag pack and thought, "Why not put up flags from where their dev team started, LW/LW2?"
listing.aiSummary: Adds player faction flags inspired by XCOM and XCOM 2.

description:
I noticed a Terra Invicta flag pack and thought, "Why not put up flags from where their dev team started, LW/LW2?"

Preview here!

Get it here!

Features:

Reapers (plus alt)
ADVENT
EXALT (plus alt)
XCOM 2 base game class icons
XCOM
XCOM:EW subfactions for genemodding and MECs

Let me know if you don't like the side columns on the XCOM 2 flags or the beveling and inner glow on the EXALT alt. It's my first time making a flag pack and I wasn't sure if variety was better than standardization.
